I’ve been struggling with insomnia for a while, and honestly, coming across this channel has been a game-changer for me. There is something so profoundly healing about the way the rain hits the leaves—it’s like the world just slows down and lets you breathe again. I’ve tried so many other sounds, but the quality here is just on another level. Thank you for putting so much care into creating this space; it’s become my nightly ritual to just close my eyes, listen to this, and let everything go. Truly grateful for your work!
